page.overview:
What is Unified Ruurian Colonies?

The Unified Ruurian Colonies were a group of planets in the Tingel Arm of the Outer Rim Territories controlled by the Ruurian species from Ruuria.

In 19 ABY, the region was headed by Amisus, who surrendered it to the Imperial Remnant, which was being represented by an imposter of Thrawn during the Caamas Document Crisis.
